concepts.def: Analysing similarities and differences in two texts
Opposing views poets present on a theme
Movement valuing nature, feeling and the sublime
Poems about the experience of war
Poem spoken by a single character
The attitude or feeling behind a poem

walkthroughs.body_html:
Strong comparison uses connective phrases: similarly, in contrast, whereas, both poets.

Compare ideas, methods, and effects — not just "both use enjambment".

Both are dramatic monologues about powerful men.

But Shelley mocks Ozymandias from a distance; Browning lets the Duke incriminate himself. Different methods, same theme: the abuse of power.

A top thesis: Both Shelley and Browning expose how absolute power corrupts, but Shelley mocks it across time while Browning makes the reader an uncomfortable witness.

Now every paragraph proves your argument.

mcqs.q: Ozymandias and My Last Duchess share which form?
Which movement valued nature, feeling and the sublime?

numericals.q: How many poems do you compare in the AQA anthology essay?
numericals.hint: One named in the question, one of your choice.

free_texts.q: What word names the attitude or feeling behind a poem? One word.
